print.name: K989 Drift wheels
print.description:
A set of drift wheels for the WLToys K989 rc car.

There is a right and left wheel so that the angle of the spokes look the same. But there is no problem with putting them on either side of the car.

I have printed these wheels in both PLA and PETG and they seem to hold up well even when drifting on asphalt.
